props.gloss_en: our master, teach us the paths of life, and we will merit through them the life of the world to come
be careful of the honour of your colleagues
and keep your children from הגיון
and seat them between the knees of Torah scholars
and when you pray, know before Whom you stand
and through this you will merit the life of the world to come
when he saw them he began to weep
lamp of Israel, right-hand pillar, mighty hammer -- why do you weep?

were they leading me before a king of flesh and blood -- here today and in the grave tomorrow, whose anger, bonds and killing are not eternal, whom I can appease with words and bribe with money -- even so I would weep

and now they lead me before the King of the kings of kings, the Holy One, who lives and endures forever, whose anger, bonds and killing are eternal, whom I cannot appease with words or bribe with money
and more: two paths are before me, one of the Garden of Eden and one of Gehinnom, and I do not know on which they are leading me -- and shall I not weep?
[asked to bless them,] he said: may it be [His] will that the fear of Heaven be upon you like the fear of flesh and blood
know that when a man commits a transgression, he says: let no man see me
clear out the vessels because of the impurity
and prepare a chair for Hezekiah king of Judah, who is coming
